main_text.p: Ebn Phares Author libri اللغة &c.] ابو الحسين احمد بن فارس بن زكريا الرازي Abul Hosain Ahmed Ebn Phares, Ebn Zacaria &c. Al-Razi, seu Raiensis: obiit anno H. 390. vel juxta alios 395. at prior sententia magis probatur, teste Ebn Chalecan.
Mohammed Ebn Salam ] محمد بن سلام الجمحي Mohammed Ebn Salam Aljamabi. Librum ejus طبقات الشعرا seu Classes Poetarum, citat author libri Mezhar.159.
Marzuki ] ابو علي احمد بن محمد بن الحسين Abu Ali Ahmed Ebn Moham-med, Ebnol Hosain AlMarZuki Al-Asphahani. المرزوقي في الاصفهاني Commentarium scripsit in librum AlHamasah, &c.

AlHamasah ] الحماسة Liber est antiquorum apud Arabes poëtarum excerpta continens, à celebri Poëta AbuTemam concinnatus. Est autem ille ابو تمام Abu Temam Habib Ebn حبيب بن اوس الطائي Aus &c. AlTai, seu Taiensis. afferunt nonnulli (referente Ebn Chalec. patrem ipsius Christianum fuisse nomine ثيودوس puto Theodosium) quod in اوس conversum Ob librum istum non minus quam quae ipse composuit poëmata clarus, eodem teste: qui etiam refert ipsum à principe quodam ob carmen ipsi oblatum خمسين الف درهم quinquagies mille aureis remuneratum, hoc insuper elogio لها لبون شعرك Est hoc infra poematis tui dignitatem, & de alia ab ipso compositâ elegiâ انا لم يمت من رثي non mortuum esse qui hoc deflevetur carmine, adeo ut se vicariâ morte ipsius vitam & famam redemisse

page.notes: Arabic words are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan; the vowel-less Arabic in the Hamasah entry (especially the proper names and the verse line) is uncertain and may contain errors. The "159." in the left margin is a section number. The Greek-derived name ثيودوس is printed in Arabic letters and is uncertain.
